scripts.dev: pnpm nx build functions && node tools/flags/write-functions-env.mjs --project demo-creativo-test && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project demo-creativo-test --ui "pnpm run seed:dev && node tools/dev-host.mjs && pnpm nx serve web --host 0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts"
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-creativo-test "pnpm nx run-many -t test-integration"
scripts.e2e:web: pnpm nx build functions && node tools/flags/write-functions-env.mjs --project demo-creativo-test && START_LOGGING_EMULATOR=true firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project demo-creativo-test "pnpm nx e2e web"
scripts.verify:p0: pnpm nx build functions && node tools/flags/write-functions-env.mjs --project demo-creativo-test && START_LOGGING_EMULATOR=true firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project demo-creativo-test "node tools/verify/p0/verify-p0.mjs"
scripts.verify:csp: pnpm nx build web && node tools/verify/csp/check-csp.mjs && pnpm nx build web --configuration=csp-smoke && node tools/verify/csp/check-csp.mjs --dist=dist/apps/web-csp-smoke/browser && pnpm nx build functions && node tools/flags/write-functions-env.mjs --project demo-creativo-test && node tools/verify/csp/emulator-config.mjs && START_LOGGING_EMULATOR=true firebase emulators:exec --config dist/firebase.csp-smoke.json --only firestore,auth,functions,storage,hosting --project demo-creativo-test "pnpm nx run web:e2e-csp"
